In detail

Sant'Alessandro is a small, largely residential zone in Municipio IV near the boundary with the Nomentano area. Searches turned up no significant documented pattern of crime or safety concerns specific to this zone; the only notable item found was an attempted break-in at a supermarket on Via Nomentana. No specific safety concerns are documented in recent local press for this area beyond that isolated incident, so a green rating applies day and night.
